project() calls that auditor but copies only flat member/row/mouse/compartment plus numeric features/flags, dropping FOV/session/dendrite identity from historical export.

authority_limits: All helpers are operator-construction functions, not authenticators or participant interfaces.
Exact source closure and unchanged observation export must be authenticated before any real call.
No source dictionary, observation array, label list or private grade was read; no pickle imported/deserialized.
The helper supports narrow standard scalar spellings; unrecognized source classes/dtypes refuse instead of coercing. Authentic token-type support is not yet measured.
No primary estimand, matching, multiplicity, chronology, readiness or central authority change.
No authentic-data/model/scientific run, web request, source download or dependency install. Two bounded generated-software test attempts are recorded separately.
